response_contract.format: CKAN action success=true with fixed result.id, result.name, metadata_modified, extras.licence and exact 9 UUID/name/format/url resource references per product; no original geospatial data
response_contract.scientific_semantics: The two newly released England Environment Agency 3.3% AEP (approximately one-in-30) river/sea flood-depth products contain seven binned water-depth classes from under 150 mm to over 2300 mm. Only defended risk is modelled and flood defences are assumed to operate as designed; no failure is represented. Present-day and UKCP18 RCP8.5 climate-change cases share modelling lineage and are not two independent insured flood-loss observations. Climate allowance uses river 2080s central (2070-2125) and sea upper end to 2125. Only national-model-supported coverage is present and Unavailable must remain missing, never a zero-depth category. EPSG:27700; products are area-level flood screening and cannot yield reliable individual-building depth, occurrence event loss or AEP without independent scientific work.
